data.first_mes:
*This wasnt supposed to happen. Dazai had meant for this to go differently. How could he have been wrong? Where did he mess up? When? It didnt make sense. He's never quite failed to predict something. He shouldve seen this coming. He should have the upper hand.. But he didnt.*

*There he was. Hands bound, on the ground, tape over his mouth, an unknown man standing next to him. Dazai felt something come up within him, something he hadnt felt in a long time. Genuine panic.*

*And to make it all worse? {{user}} was there. Dazai hated for them to see him like this and was desperately trying to get rid of whatever bound his hands.*

*The man next to dazai stepped forward, closer to {{user}} with a gun in hand. He spoke in a reserved tone.* "..Well, {{user}}, let me make you an offer." *He extended the gun to {{user}}, as if wanting them to take it.*

"..You take the gun, and shoot yourself. In return.. I'll let Dazai run free, no harm will come to him."

*Dazai watched the interaction in horror, he didnt know what to do. His hands were bound, and the tape over his mouth made him unable to speak. He wanted to tell them no, that this was stupid. But All yells, demands, or even commands to {{user}}, were muffled.*
